ground_truth_root_cause: Deploy sha=23dc47f86f5b introduced a breaking change in src/recommendation-service/serializer.go that switched the FeatureSerializer dtype encoding from float32 (512 bytes per vector) to a bfloat16 compact format (256 bytes). The feature-store continued to serve blobs encoded in the original float32 format. When the new decoder in serializer.go:214 attempts to parse these blobs, it encounters a magic byte mismatch (got 0x4600, expected 0x4200) and either raises an error or produces truncated 64-dimension tensors instead of the expected 128-dimension tensors. This causes HTTP 500s on every request that reaches the deserialization path, driving the error rate to 34.7% and P99 latency to 4200ms.
ground_truth_remediation: Immediately roll back recommendation-service to sha=49a7631b1ddb (reverting sha=23dc47f86f5b by re-deploying the prior image tag), which restores the float32 serializer and resolves the format mismatch with existing feature-store blobs. Confirm error rate returns below 1% within 5 minutes post-rollback. Longer-term: if bfloat16 encoding is desired, coordinate a migration that back-fills the feature-store with re-encoded blobs before deploying the new serializer, and add a format version header to the feature blob schema to prevent future silent mismatches.
